state.title: docs(deps): record why the bd pin cannot move to a newer-numbered release
state.body:
## Summary

`deps.env` has long carried an instruction to promote `BD_VERSION` off `v1.1.0` "the day" beads publishes a release with the `--if-assignee`/`--if-status` conditional-write flags. beads has since shipped `v1.2.1` and `v1.2.2`, both dated after those flags landed in [beads#5008](https://github.com/gastownhall/beads/pull/5008), so the pin looked promotable. It isn't. The reason is one the old comment couldn't have anticipated: a beads tag's number doesn't order its capabilities.

beads cuts stable hotfixes off the `v1.1.0` line, which branched three weeks before the flags landed. That line is linear, it never merged to main, and both `v1.1.2` and the newest **stable** release `v1.2.2` sit on it. Neither one carries `--if-assignee` at all. `v1.2.1` is the first release that clears beads#5008 and it does carry both flags, but GitHub marks it a prerelease, so it doesn't meet the published bar this pin holds the installable default to.

So the pin stays where it is, and this change records why. It rewrites the `BD_VERSION` rationale in `deps.env`, names the two conditions that gate the next attempt, and sweeps the now-falsified "no published release has the flags" claim out of the five other places that asserted it: the `BD_PREV_VERSION` floor note, three comments across `internal/beads`, and the integration test's skip-and-fatal message. That last one is the one to look at, since it's the only site a human reads at runtime. **Comments and messages only: every pinned value is byte-identical to main.**

```mermaid
gitGraph
   commit id: "v1.1.0 base"
   branch hotfix-line
   commit id: "v1.1.2 (no flags)"
   commit id: "v1.2.2 (no flags, STABLE)"
   checkout main
   commit id: "beads#5008 flags"
   commit id: "v1.2.1 (flags, PRERELEASE)"
   commit id: "main"
```

## Risk

There's none to CI behaviour. No pinned version, SHA, or workflow `BD_VERSION` block moves, so every job installs exactly the bd it installed before. If CI goes red here, it won't be from this diff.

<details> <summary>Verification, and the two conditions that gate promotion</summary>

### How each claim was checked

Capability was measured against the published tarballs rather than inferred from version numbers, which is the same method the original comment used for `v1.1.2`:

| Release | Published | GitHub state | `bd update --help` names `--if-assignee` |
|---|---|---|---|
| `v1.1.2` | 2026-07-26 | stable | no |
| `v1.2.1` | 2026-08-11 | prerelease | **yes**, with the exit-13 semantics |
| `v1.2.2` | 2026-08-15 | stable | no |

Ancestry, via the compare API against `gastownhall/beads`:

- The hotfix line is linear and rooted before the flags: [`8e4e59d39`](https://github.com/gastownhall/beads/commit/8e4e59d39f3459a43cf21a3236a13eca4dd874f7) (2026-07-04) → +4 → `v1.1.2` → +7 → `v1.2.2`.
- Neither `v1.1.2` nor `v1.2.2` is an ancestor of beads `main`; each holds commits main does not.
- `v1.2.1` **is** an ancestor of beads `main` (main is 9 commits ahead, `v1.2.1` behind by none), and [`6e8af8bf8`](https://github.com/gastownhall/beads/commit/6e8af8bf8) is an ancestor of `v1.2.1`.

### Two conditions gate the next attempt

1. beads publishes a non-prerelease release cut from main, and its per-platform tarball SHAs go into `.github/scripts/install-bd-archive.sh`.
2. The fresh managed-Dolt bootstrap fix in [#5294](https://github.com/gastownhall/gascity/pull/5294) lands first. bd 1.2 added a legacy-workspace guard that refuses a pre-existing `.beads/dolt` carrying no version witness, so a fresh city under a 1.2 pin fails init until the witness is written for a proven-fresh database. That PR is open as of this writing.

Until both hold, the only flag-capable bd CI can obtain stays the source-built `BD_CURRENT_REF` cell, which is where the `ReleaseIfCurrent` CAS contract already runs.

### Every site the claim appeared in

| File | Site | Action |
|---|---|---|
| `deps.env` | `BD_VERSION` rationale | rewritten |
| `deps.env` | `BD_PREV_VERSION` floor note | corrected |
| `internal/beads/bdstore_conditional_release.go` | package comment | corrected |
| `internal/beads/bdstore.go` | `ReleaseIfCurrent` doc comment | corrected |
| `internal/beads/bdstore_conditional_release_integration_test.go` | test doc comment | corrected |
| `internal/beads/bdstore_conditional_release_integration_test.go` | skip and fatal message | corrected, runtime-visible |

Three further sites were checked and deliberately left alone, each re-verified as still true: the `.github/workflows/ci.yml` comment saying `BD_VERSION` "is a published release that predates it"; `bdstore_test.go`; and the graduation test, which is about `--if-revision`, a different flag absent from both `v1.2.1` and `v1.2.2`.

### Checks run

- `sh -n deps.env`, and sourcing it to confirm `BD_VERSION` and `BD_PREV_VERSION` read back unchanged.
- `diff` of the non-comment lines against `origin/main`: identical.
- `gofmt -l`, `go build ./internal/beads/...`, `go vet ./internal/beads/...`: all clean, before and after the round-1 sweep.
- Test packages under `internal/beads` compile; nothing asserts on any string touched.
- `git diff --check`: clean.

</details>
